definitions: A thing that lies over, on, or in front of something else, typically in order to protect or conceal it.
A covering for a book or magazine.
A blanket or other covering designed to be used on a bed.
A place of shelter or concealment.
A musical performance or recording of a song that has previously been recorded by someone else.
examples: He lifted the cover of the box.
The magazine cover featured a famous actress.
She pulled the covers up to her chin.
They ran for cover when it started to rain.
The band played a cover of a classic rock song.
